decisions.checklistNumbering: 1-653 plus CL-DK and CL1-CL6 disambiguate overlapping printed checklist numbers.
decisions.variations: Collapse five additional source variations to one canonical card per number. Prefer b state, corrected where labeled COR. #651 white lettering and #640 four-line biography chosen; not claims of relative scarcity.
decisions.exclusions: Oversized Super Diamond Kings are wrapper-redemption cards, box bottoms are packaging, puzzle panels are non-card accompaniments. Distinct Leaf and Highlights releases excluded.
decisions.subsets: Diamond Kings 1-26, Rated Rookies 27-46, Two For The Title 651 remain in Base.
